title: MZ RPG Maker MZ Plugin to Display Elemental Rates in Menu?

posts.author: Etrogade_
posts.body:
So, I was looking for a plugin that was similar to what the image in this post describes. The plugin provided however makes it so that it hides stats that aren't being changed
MV - Element Chart in Equip Menu/Scene
Hi,  I'm requesting for an element rates table in the Equip Menu, similar to the one in Status Menu through: Status Menu Core (YEP)  While it's nice to have changing color depending on the rates and arrows showing results after equipping, the following only would still suffice: element, icon...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Plus, I wanted something similar to this:
I know Visustella and Yanfly have plugins that show elemental status in the menus, but it doesn't really have what I'm looking for. If there is no plugin, then thank you anyways

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
I guess this is one of the cases where almost no plugin dev made a plugin because we sometimes don't want to spend time programming a functionality that is already covered by YEP / VS.
A status menu is on my list of custom menu builders (
https://aerosys.itch.io/custom-ui
), but it will likely take a few months to be ready.
